ESLint Config Generator

Generate a flat-config eslint.config.js — rule presets, browser/node globals and custom rules.

Requires: npm i -D eslint @eslint/js globals

📖 How to use

  1. Pick a rule preset (minimal, recommended-plus, strict).
  2. Toggle browser and Node.js globals.
  3. Add custom rules ("name: severity").
  4. Copy the config or download eslint.config.js.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What is the flat config?

The eslint.config.js format used by ESLint 9 — an exported array instead of the old .eslintrc files.

What do I need to install?

npm i -D eslint @eslint/js globals — the generated file imports @eslint/js and optionally globals.

How are custom rules formatted?

One per line as "rule-name: error" (or warn/off). They override the preset.

What do the environment toggles do?

They add the right globals (window/document for browser, process/__dirname for Node) so ESLint does not flag them as undefined.
